question: What honourarium did the P C Chandra Puraskaar include?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹20 lakh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **P C Chandra Puraskaar** is a prestigious national-level award instituted by the **P. C. Chandra Group**, a leading jewelry house in India.
 
• The award includes a significant **honourarium** consisting of a cash prize of **₹20 lakh**__, along with a **citation** and a trophy.
 
• It was established in the **year 1993** as a tribute to the memory of the group's founding father, **Shri Purna Chandra Chandra**.
 
• The primary objective of the award is to recognize and honor **excellence** in various fields, including **Arts, Science, Literature, Sports, and Social Service**.
 
• The award is presented annually at a grand ceremony, typically held in **Kolkata**, **West Bengal**, to individuals who have reached the pinnacle of their respective careers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Award Recipients:**
 
 
• The **P C Chandra Puraskaar** has been conferred upon many iconic Indian personalities over the years.
 
• In **2019**, the award was presented to the world-renowned cardiac surgeon and philanthropist, **Dr. Devi Shetty**.
 
• In **2018**, the legendary playback singer **Asha Bhosle** was the recipient of this honor.
 
• Other notable awardees include Nobel Peace Prize winner **Kailash Satyarthi** (**2017**), veteran actress **Hema Malini**, and legendary cricketer **Kapil Dev**.
 
 
 
• **The P. C. Chandra Group:**
 
 
• The group was founded in **1939** and has grown to become one of the most trusted jewelry brands in **East India**.
 
• The organization is deeply involved in **Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR)** activities through its various foundations.
 
• Headquartered in **Kolkata**, the group supports initiatives in **education, healthcare, and environmental sustainability**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Selection Process:** The recipient is chosen by a **specialized jury** that considers the individual’s lifetime achievements and their contribution to the nation's pride and global image.
 
• **Monetary Value:** The cash prize of **₹20 lakh** is intended to support the recipient's ongoing philanthropic work or to recognize their unparalleled dedication to their craft.
 
• **Cultural Impact:** The award ceremony is a major highlight in the cultural calendar of **Kolkata**, often featuring performances by classical artists and attended by **dignitaries** from various sectors of society.
 
• **Anniversary:** The award ceremony often coincides with the **birth anniversary** of the founder or significant milestones of the **P. C. Chandra Group**.

89:T
